methods.candidate_workaround: retain the failed aggregate at zero credit, run only the x2 scoped test module, and use the exact committed x1 blob replay plus the earlier 22-of-22 x1 result for x1 evidence
methods.recurrence_guard: never execute an x1 absence assertion in an x2 or final worktree; replace it with exact immutable-tree replay
methods.rollback: stop the combined suite without editing the immutable x1 test or deleting x2 evidence
